ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels to 15% high-intensity white/light-grey pixels concentrated at distal lobe tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white mottling focused on the outer distal edges of both lobes; left lobe displays a dense, irregular white cluster with internal dark pixel inclusions; right lobe displays an elongated white patch near the tip and isolated white pixel clusters along the margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 75 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude variations of 5-15 pixels across the entire trailing boundary; notable jagged peaks present on the outer third of the left lobe and middle section of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall concave trailing edge curvature from notch to tip, transitioning to a sharp convex upward sweep at the distal terminals.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast white pixel clusters; one prominent cluster visible on the central-left lobe and several smaller circular markings embedded within the white pigmentation of the right lobe tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single prominent diagonal linear disruption (rake mark) approximately 200 pixels in length on the lower right lobe; multiple faint, shorter linear scratches visible on the upper left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of multiple circular barnacle attachment scars and at least one distinct rake mark/linear scratch on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Vertical series of three distinct low-relief protuberances visible at the central base of the fluke near the insertion point of the peduncle.
